visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a gray professional blazer, stands in a brightly lit office hallway clutching a blue clipboard and a package of snacks; she has a determined yet nervous facial expression, whispering to herself. (2) A close-up shot of a hand holding a single hexagonal biscuit with a koala illustration and the word 'go' printed on it, positioned against a light blue background. (3) Transition to a classroom setting where the same woman is now dressed in a white puff-sleeved dress with cherry earrings, acting as an energetic teacher; she stands before a chalkboard covered in English letters and drawings, gesturing widely with a marker. (4) Scene shifts to a student's perspective where the woman appears as a student with messy hair and painted symbols on her face, leaning over a desk filled with papers, looking exhausted and confused. (5) The teacher persona is seen dancing and pointing at the board while the student persona collapses onto the desk to sleep; various graphic text and 'Z' symbols appear as overlays. (6) The woman appears in a stylized studio setting with a pink and green musical note background, playing a small white electronic keyboard with high energy, flipping her hair. (7) In a home/office environment, the woman is seen happily eating from a box of Lotte Koala's March while studying English materials, showing a transformation from frustration to enjoyment. (8) Macro close-up shots show individual biscuits featuring different koala characters and English words like 'after' and 'ball' on a wooden surface next to a pen and paper. (9) The woman returns to her professional office attire, standing in front of a laptop and windows, delivering a confident presentation while holding the clipboard and pointing at the snack product. (10) A screen recording sequence displays a green and yellow mobile interface for an AI story generation campaign, showing steps like selecting biscuits, uploading a photo, and generating a digital picture book. (11) Final montage of promotional graphics showing various flavors of the product, prizes like a koala-themed suitcase, and an Australian travel incentive, ending with the woman smiling and blowing a kiss.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female actress playing multiple roles, 1 female student seen from the back in classroom scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long light brown hair; appears in a gray blazer with a white inner top for office scenes, a white puff-sleeved dress with cherry earrings for the teacher role, and a white shirt with painted face symbols for the student role.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a modern office hallway with white doors, a traditional classroom with a green chalkboard, a colorful studio setup with musical graphics, and digital interface backgrounds for the app promotion.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Female narration begins with a shaky, nervous tone accompanied by a light piano-driven BGM. (2) A sharp 'Go!' vocal stinger and an impact sound effect trigger a shift to a high-tempo pop track. (3) The vocal persona shifts to 'Teacher Tatiana', speaking English at a rapid, enthusiastic pace with clear articulation. (4) A comic 'Z' snoring sound effect plays as the vocal tone becomes muffled, representing the sleeping student. (5) Loud desk thud and sharp 'Whoosh' transition effects accompany the teacher's yelling of 'Apple!', punctuated by canned laughter and applause. (6) Upbeat singing starts with the lyrics 'Wake up wake up...', featuring bright synthesizer textures and a steady dance beat. (7) Narrative voice returns to a calm, professional tone explaining the benefits of the product over the persistent upbeat BGM. (8) Digital UI clicks, shutter sounds, and sparkle 'Ding' effects are layered during the mobile app demonstration. (9) The audio concludes with a high-pitched, joyful exclamation of 'Love U' and a final energetic musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Backstory -> Problem -> Solution -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative commercial for Lotte Koala's March biscuits (English version), using a role-playing narrative to demonstrate how the snack can make learning English fun and stress-free. It further promotes a digital engagement campaign involving AI story generation and high-value travel prizes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is structured as a pitch/proposal for the product, with clear branding, product usage, and a detailed call to action for a promotional event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-energy social media editing style with frequent transitions and on-screen graphics to maintain viewer engagement. The dual-persona performance effectively builds a relatable narrative arc that transitions from office pressure to educational humor and finally to product promotion.
